statusDetail: Complete atomic audit of 58 checks across five representative public paths. Authenticated messaging, checkout/payment completion and account settings were not covered because they require a user account; the audited primary public journey was search/listing/detail plus the seller entry.

page.notes: Server-rendered marketplace with client hydration, separate account domains, manifest, advertising and analytics integrations.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Screenshot comparison found the dark capture byte-identical to the light capture; the UI remains white under prefers-color-scheme: dark.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the probe found zero active animations and three reduced-motion CSS rules.
Lighthouse failed color contrast and the high-contrast capture was used to inspect control visibility.
Rendered HTML includes the cross-document @view-transition initialization and pageswap/pagereveal handling.
DOM/CSS probes found no scroll-linked effects or animation-timeline use on the representative pages, so no JS scroll-animation anti-pattern was present.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile walkthroughs showed native scrolling and ordinary links/buttons; no custom pointer-driven gesture surface was present.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Long listing/detail pages retain static navigation chrome; the CSS probe found no scroll timeline/state treatment to guide long-page position.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The listing account callout remained attached within the viewport without clipping at 360px.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Listing and detail views provide breadcrumbs and a prominent “Torna alla ricerca” return action.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The listing mobile capture shows an unsolicited “Accedi ora” callout covering search controls, alongside a persistent promotional banner.
DOM found a SECTION with role=dialog; Lighthouse reports aria-dialog-name failure, indicating custom dialog semantics without an accessible name.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile home, listing, detail and sell captures devote the majority of viewport space to search, listings, item imagery or the selling task.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using mobile layout metrics
checkOutcomes.evidence: Layout at 360x800 reported scrollWidth=clientWidth=360 and zero horizontal overflow on all four representative templates.
CSS probe counted 13 container-query rules and all representative templates adapted cleanly at 360px.
Lighthouse failed target-size; the probe counted 177 rendered interactive boxes below 24px in at least one dimension, while keyboard outline was visible.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: First-view captures clearly expose Cerca on home/listing, item identity and price on detail, and “Inserisci il tuo annuncio” on sell.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The public browse journey was completed from home to listing to a live item detail with a clear return path; the sell entry surface also loaded.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: A deliberately unknown route rendered “Servizio non disponibile… Torna tra poco” but provided no home, back, retry, search, or support action.
Lighthouse performance was 0.56 with LCP 12.2s, CLS 0.119 and TBT 200ms; a warm raw-CDP trace was faster (LCP 1.69s), showing condition sensitivity but not negating the throttled failure.
Lighthouse measured CLS 0.119, found three layout shifts, and flagged unsized images; the image audit found 39 images without explicit dimensions.
Lighthouse measured 3.0s main-thread work and 1.7s JavaScript execution, despite the warm trace observing no long tasks.
HAR recorded 120 requests and 3.24MB, nine parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority stylesheets; Lighthouse estimated 1.18s render-blocking savings.
Lighthouse estimated 657KiB unused JavaScript and 38KiB unused CSS; HAR recorded 43 script requests transferring 1.85MB.
Lighthouse failed aria-dialog-name and link-name; the image audit also reported 23 images without alt attributes (some decorative).
Lighthouse’s automated WCAG contrast audit failed on the home template.
Lighthouse failed heading-order and agent accessibility-tree checks; the homepage DOM had no h1, though a focused link had a visible auto outline.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile screenshots show readable, unclipped Italian headings, labels, prices and body text across all four templates.
Viewport permits scaling and 360px reflow has no overflow, but Lighthouse failed touch-target sizing. No essential video/audio was present.
Lighthouse recorded browser console errors during its full load, while the later three-second page probe observed none.
Document has HTML doctype and UTF-8, but Lighthouse flagged unsized images and the image audit found 39 missing dimensions plus 17 oversized assets.
Lighthouse best-practices scored 0.96; no permission request fired on load and the runtime probe found no immediate uncaught error.
Home, listing, detail and sell templates have distinct descriptive titles and meta descriptions.
Viewport and robots are present, but Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors; recon found multiple category links resolving only to the homepage “#”.
Home/listing/detail have sound indexing signals, but the sell template lacked a canonical and /sitemap.xml returned 503 during the audit.
Home/listing/detail include JSON-LD plus Open Graph metadata; the item detail contained four JSON-LD blocks matching the visible listing.
HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff and SAMEORIGIN are present, but CSP is absent and didomi_dcs is not Secure; two cookies use SameSite=None.
Tracker capture found 20 third-party origins and seven known tracker domains; HAR attributed 83 requests and 2.51MB to non-main origins.
No permission request fired on load, but recon of the visible authentication entry found no evidence of passkey/WebAuthn support for this account-based marketplace.
HSTS, X-Frame-Options and Referrer-Policy are present, but CSP and Permissions-Policy are absent; cookies include SameSite=None and one non-Secure cookie.
Discoverability fetch returned 200 with 74% rendered-word coverage in raw HTML; title and description survive without JavaScript and it is not a JS shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using mobile layout metrics
checkOutcomes.evidence: Menus/callouts and long templates stayed within the 360px viewport; layouts had zero horizontal overflow and no broken shell.
A manifest exists but uses display:"browser" and prefer_related_applications:true; runtime probe found no controlling service worker.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Unknown-route test produced a branded error message but no actionable retry, home, search, back, or support control.
HTML correctly declares lang=it and dir=ltr, but CSS probe counted 189 physical left/right-style rules, limiting writing-mode resilience.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The Italian detail template renders “75.000 €” and Italian relative/date text consistent with the declared it locale.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Visible listing timestamps are expressed in local Italian terms and no cross-time-zone scheduling surface appeared in the representative paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Public search, listing, item price and sell entry use direct labels; no forced continuity, disguised ad action, or confirmshaming was observed in the exercised paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The sell entry asks for an item name or category with explanatory copy before deeper validation; no premature invalid state appeared.
Search and geo inputs, plus the sell item-name input, explicitly use autocomplete="off", preventing useful browser assistance.

checkOutcomes.method: Active review using visual screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The item detail exposes the full €75,000 price before contact and account actions are explicitly labelled; no subscription commitment was encountered.
Image audit found 17 oversized, 20 without srcset, 16 legacy-format and 23 below-fold non-lazy images.
HAR loaded 120 resources and 43 scripts on the landing page, including ad/analytics work; 83 requests were outside the main origin.
2.51MB of 3.24MB transferred from non-main origins; GTM, consent and ad scripts were among the largest payloads.
The emerging agent-capability check is not applicable: no declared agent-facing product intent or WebMCP surface was in scope.

checkOutcomes.reason: The emerging on-device-inference check is not applicable: the marketplace paths expose no summarisation or language-model task.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Heap after ten bottom/top scroll cycles was 39.5MB/714k nodes versus 26.4MB/438k baseline. Separate browser sessions and dynamic content reduce confidence, but the 49.8% retained-size signal warrants investigation.
Baseline heap contained 437,993 nodes and 26.4MB self size before interaction, high for a landing/listing surface and consistent with the heavy script footprint.
Neither heap summary exposed Detached* constructors among retained constructor summaries; no direct detached-DOM signal was found, though timer instrumentation was limited.

principleOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing intent or applicable inference task was present in the audited public marketplace paths.

paths.description: Homepage and primary search entry; represents discovery, navigation and landing-page behavior.
National used-item results; represents listing/filter/search-result template.
Live boat advert; represents item detail, price, seller/contact and rich metadata.
Sell landing and item-name/category entry; represents the seller task start.

findings.summary: Honours prefers-color-scheme: a usable dark mode exists and is driven by the user's preference (color-scheme / prefers-color-scheme / light-dark()), not hard-coded light only.
findings.evidence: Screenshot comparison found the dark capture byte-identical to the light capture; the UI remains white under prefers-color-scheme: dark.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “dark-mode”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Honours prefers-contrast / forced-colors: controls, text and scrollbars remain visible under high-contrast preferences.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed color contrast and the high-contrast capture was used to inspect control visibility.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “adapt-scrollbar-to-contrast-preferences”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Sticky/affixed UI reacts to scroll state and position (e.g. the new scroll-state(scrolled) query, shrinking headers, progress indicators) so chrome responds to position instead of static or JS-driven toggling.
findings.evidence: Long listing/detail pages retain static navigation chrome; the CSS probe found no scroll timeline/state treatment to guide long-page position.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “shrinking-header-on-scroll”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: No intrusive pop-ups, interstitials or banners that obscure content on load; overlays are dismissible and content-first.
findings.evidence: The listing mobile capture shows an unsolicited “Accedi ora” callout covering search controls, alongside a persistent promotional banner.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “light-dismiss-a-dialog”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Overlays and rich controls use the right primitive: popover (with declarative light-dismiss) for transient UI, dialog for modal flows, details for disclosure, native-but-branded selects and pickers, rather than ad-hoc divs.
findings.evidence: DOM found a SECTION with role=dialog; Lighthouse reports aria-dialog-name failure, indicating custom dialog semantics without an accessible name.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “declarative-dialog-popover-control”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Touch targets are adequately sized and hover-only affordances have a non-hover fallback, and keyboard focus is visible, so the UI works for touch, pointer and keyboard alike.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed target-size; the probe counted 177 rendered interactive boxes below 24px in at least one dimension, while keyboard outline was visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “accessibility”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Loading, empty, success, error, offline, and partial-completion states are visible and actionable; users can retry, undo, cancel, go back, or continue without losing context.
findings.evidence: A deliberately unknown route rendered “Servizio non disponibile… Torna tra poco” but provided no home, back, retry, search, or support action.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “accessible-error-announcement”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Core Web Vitals are in the good range: LCP is fast, interaction latency (INP) is low, and CLS is minimal; work is prioritised and deferred sensibly.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse performance was 0.56 with LCP 12.2s, CLS 0.119 and TBT 200ms; a warm raw-CDP trace was faster (LCP 1.69s), showing condition sensitivity but not negating the throttled failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “identify-inp-causes”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: No cumulative layout shift from late content (images, banners, fonts) that arrives without reserved space.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 0.119, found three layout shifts, and flagged unsized images; the image audit found 39 images without explicit dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “visually-stable-font-fallbacks”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: The main thread is not blocked by long tasks or heavy scripting; work is deferred, chunked, prioritised, or moved off-thread.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 3.0s main-thread work and 1.7s JavaScript execution, despite the warm trace observing no long tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “break-up-long-tasks”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Critical resources are delivered efficiently: cache headers are useful, render-blocking chains are short, fonts do not block or shift text, HTTP delivery is modern, and network dependency trees do not delay the main content.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 120 requests and 3.24MB, nine parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority stylesheets; Lighthouse estimated 1.18s render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “optimize-image-priority”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: The page does not ship large unused or duplicated JavaScript/CSS, avoidable legacy bundles, or third-party code that dominates the load without user value.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 657KiB unused JavaScript and 38KiB unused CSS; HAR recorded 43 script requests transferring 1.85MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “identify-heavy-scripts”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Interactive elements have accessible names, correct roles, and form fields have labels; images have alt text where meaningful; canvas/expressive content is exposed to assistive technology.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed aria-dialog-name and link-name; the image audit also reported 23 images without alt attributes (some decorative).
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “accessibility”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Text and essential UI meet WCAG colour-contrast minimums against their background.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s automated WCAG contrast audit failed on the home template.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “accessibility”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Heading and landmark structure is logical, focus order follows reading order, keyboard focus is always visible, and interactive state survives DOM moves.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed heading-order and agent accessibility-tree checks; the homepage DOM had no h1, though a focused link had a visible auto outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “move-dom-element-without-losing-state”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: The experience remains usable when zoomed or reflowed, touch targets are large enough, media has captions or equivalents where needed, and the viewport does not prevent user scaling.
findings.evidence: Viewport permits scaling and 360px reflow has no overflow, but Lighthouse failed touch-target sizing. No essential video/audio was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “accessibility”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: The page loads without console errors or uncaught exceptions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded browser console errors during its full load, while the later three-second page probe observed none.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “accessibility”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Valid doctype and charset, images sized with correct aspect ratio, no deprecated APIs misused, and CSS/HTML are well structured and not needlessly repetitive. (HTTPS, CSP and permission hygiene are judged under be-private-and-secure, not here.)
findings.evidence: Document has HTML doctype and UTF-8, but Lighthouse flagged unsized images and the image audit found 39 missing dimensions plus 17 oversized assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “css”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Links are crawlable (real href), there is a viewport meta tag, robots does not block indexing, and link text is descriptive.
findings.evidence: Viewport and robots are present, but Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors; recon found multiple category links resolving only to the homepage “#”.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “accessibility”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Public pages expose the indexing signals search engines need: successful HTTP status, canonical URL when appropriate, hreflang for localized variants, robots/sitemap consistency, and no accidental noindex/noarchive policy.
findings.evidence: Home/listing/detail have sound indexing signals, but the sell template lacked a canonical and /sitemap.xml returned 503 during the audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “accessibility”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Served over HTTPS with a sensible Content-Security-Policy and secure, SameSite cookies; no mixed content or obvious transport/header smells.
findings.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff and SAMEORIGIN are present, but CSP is absent and didomi_dcs is not Secure; two cookies use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “security”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: No over-collection of user data, no leaky third parties, and analytics/background data collection is minimised and batched rather than chatty or session-wide by default.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture found 20 third-party origins and seven known tracker domains; HAR attributed 83 requests and 2.51MB to non-main origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “privacy”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Permission prompts are requested in context (not on load), and authentication uses modern, phishing-resistant methods (passkeys / WebAuthn) where relevant rather than passwords alone.
findings.evidence: No permission request fired on load, but recon of the visible authentication entry found no evidence of passkey/WebAuthn support for this account-based marketplace.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “passkeys”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are configured where appropriate: HSTS, clickjacking protection (frame-ancestors / X-Frame-Options), Trusted Types for XSS-sensitive apps, origin isolation, privacy-preserving third-party cookie posture, and sensible Referrer-Policy / Permissions-Policy.
findings.evidence: HSTS, X-Frame-Options and Referrer-Policy are present, but CSP and Permissions-Policy are absent; cookies include SameSite=None and one non-Secure cookie.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “security”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Where the site is an app, it is installable (web app manifest) and offers an offline fallback and works on flaky networks. (Contextual: a brochure or intrinsically-online site may reasonably not need this.)
findings.evidence: A manifest exists but uses display:"browser" and prefer_related_applications:true; runtime probe found no controlling service worker.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “accessibility”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: HTTP errors, network failures, timeouts and stale data states are handled intentionally: users see useful recovery options rather than blank screens, infinite spinners, broken shells, or misleading success states.
findings.evidence: Unknown-route test produced a branded error message but no actionable retry, home, search, back, or support control.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “persistent-toast-notifications”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Correct lang and dir attributes, logical CSS properties (inline/block) rather than physical left/right, and translation-ready markup so the layout and reading order survive other languages and writing modes.
findings.evidence: HTML correctly declares lang=it and dir=ltr, but CSS probe counted 189 physical left/right-style rules, limiting writing-mode resilience.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “translator”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Input is assisted, not obstructed: correct autocomplete tokens so address, payment, sign-in and sign-up fields autofill, and inputs are highlighted/sized to help the user rather than trip them up.
findings.evidence: Search and geo inputs, plus the sell item-name input, explicitly use autocomplete="off", preventing useful browser assistance.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “autofill-address-form”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Images and decorative assets are optimised and served at appropriate resolutions; decorative pseudo-element imagery and heavy decorative images are resolution-optimised rather than oversized.

findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “deliver-optimized-decorative-images”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Background work and fetching are not wasteful: background processing is efficient and de-prioritised, and the lightest technique that achieves the result is preferred over heavy or redundant work.

findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “deprioritize-background-fetches”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts, fonts, video, audio, animation and heavy media are proportionate to the user value they provide; autoplay or background media is avoided unless essential and resource use is cached or deferred where possible.
findings.evidence: 2.51MB of 3.24MB transferred from non-main origins; GTM, consent and ad scripts were among the largest payloads.
findings.suggestedFix: Address this check using Modern Web Guidance “deliver-optimized-decorative-images”; verify under the same audited condition and retain before/after evidence.
